title: Lost Mary Strawberry Cherry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Lost Mary Strawberry Cherry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid provides a highly vibrant and multi-layered fruit experience. This masterfully crafted blend layers the soft, jammy sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the deep, bold intensity of juicy Cherries. A bright, tangy note of Raspberry rounds out the exhale, adding a complex fruit finish that creates a deeply satisfying and consistently flavour-packed vape for berry lovers. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Lost Mary Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Lost Mary Nic Salts collection delivers the same intense and globally popular flavours that made their single-use devices famous, now in a convenient 10ml refillable format. Beyond the rich berry notes of Strawberry Cherry Raspberry, vapers can explore other vibrant options within the range, such as the crisp Double Apple or the refreshing Blueberry Raspberry. It is the perfect choice for those seeking a premium, flavour-packed experience in a more cost-effective format. Compatible with refillable pod vape or vape starter kit UK devices for smooth hits.
